description: Every check common-checks runs, and the modules that carry each one's rules. Consumers that re-run these checks outside a workflow read this file so they cannot drift from the composite. Paths are repo-relative. A check with no modules states why nothing importable carries its rule.

checks.name: run-once
checks.reason: it claims the workflow run for one job. There is no rule a file can break.

checks.name: yaml-comment-block
checks.reason: its rule lives in wow-look-at-my/slopfmt, which owns every prose and YAML rule the org applies. The action installs that binary and runs `slopfmt workflows`, so this repository carries nothing importable to drift from it.

checks.name: push-excludes-tags
checks.reason: its rule is an inline script inside a composite action, which nothing can import. Converting it to a node action to expose one eight-line rule cost 642 lines against 34, 386 of them a lockfile, on an action every repository in the org runs.
